title: Fire alarm systems
description: Addressable and conventional systems designed around your building, from installation to testing and commissioning.
detail: Share the building type, floor area, preferred panel and whether this is a new installation or an upgrade.

title: Gas suppression
description: Suppression solutions for spaces where equipment and business continuity matter. Start with a site-specific assessment.
detail: Include room dimensions, occupancy and equipment to be protected. System selection requires an engineering assessment.

title: Programming & BMS
description: Fire alarm programming, testing and integration with building management systems for a connected facility.
detail: Share the panel manufacturer, exact model, firmware and integration requirements.

title: CCTV & access control
description: Video surveillance and controlled access for commercial, industrial and residential properties.
detail: Include entry points, proposed camera locations, recording needs and existing systems.

title: AMC & CMC services
description: Preventive maintenance, system health checks and breakdown support to keep installed systems ready.
detail: Share the equipment list, site location and required service scope for a maintenance proposal.

title: Equipment sourcing
description: Find fire and security equipment for your project. Confirm specifications and availability before ordering.
detail: Provide the manufacturer, part number, quantity and delivery location. Pricing is confirmed in a written quotation.
